turns.answer:
For a weekend trip, I'd look for a portable power station under 10 lb with a 100W USB-C PD output and at least 250Wh of battery capacity.

The important distinction is that 100W USB-C is the charging speed, not the battery capacity. A power station can support 100W laptop charging but still run out after only a few hours.

For a two-day trip:

200Wh: Good for roughly 1–2 full laptop recharges.

250–300Wh: Better balance of weight and weekend capacity.

300Wh+: Preferable if you'll be working heavily and won't have access to an outlet.

These estimates depend on your laptop's battery size and conversion losses.
